title: Fix 'Unauthorized: Only admins can add questions' error on Admin Panel

requirements.text: Remove the 'Unauthorized: Only admins can add questions' error banner from the Admin Panel screen. The backend `addQuestion` update function in `backend/main.mo` must accept calls from any caller (authenticated or anonymous) without performing any role or principal check that causes a rejection or trap. Remove all authorization guards from both `addQuestion` and `getAdminQuestions` in the backend so they are fully open to any caller.

quotes: Unauthorized: Only admins can add questions

acceptanceCriteria: The backend `addQuestion` function compiles and executes without trapping for anonymous callers.
The backend `getAdminQuestions` function returns results to any caller without a role check.
No authorization guard or caller identity check remains in either function.

requirements.text: In `AdminPanelScreen.tsx`, remove any frontend-side error display, conditional render, or access check that shows the 'Unauthorized: Only admins can add questions' message or hides the Add Question form behind a role check. The password gate (password: 'Naeem9472') must remain as the only gate. Once the correct password is entered, the Add Question form and the Questions list must both be fully visible and functional with no unauthorized error shown.

quotes: Unauthorized: Only admins can add questions

acceptanceCriteria: After entering the correct password 'Naeem9472', the Add Question form is visible with no unauthorized error banner.
The 'Unauthorized: Only admins can add questions' red error message is never shown.
The Questions list loads and displays backend questions without any unauthorized error.
The password gate still prevents access before the correct password is entered.

constraints: The admin password gate ('Naeem9472') must remain in place — do not remove it.
Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
All Motoko logic must remain in the single main actor file (backend/main.mo).
nonGoals: Adding new question fields or changing the question schema.
Modifying the quiz, review, or history screens.
